pages.text: $(bold)Triple Suffering$(): three calamities converge; nothing can be avoided.$(br2)$(bold)Expansion$(): press the domain expansion key to unfold the domain around yourself - it seals its occupants in like any other domain, draining radius x45 curse power per second. While the domain is active, the caster's attacks $(red)always land on targets inside the domain$():$(br2)1) Projectile homing: every projectile the caster fires (bows, crossbows, Tinkers' bows and crossbows, guns, Construct-technique shots, and so on) is corrected each tick toward the nearest hostile target inside the domain - $(bold)even a shot that went wide curves back to hit$().

$(bold)2) Guaranteed empty-swing hits$(): when the caster left-clicks while holding a $(bold)Construct-technique fabricated weapon$() or a $(bold)ranged weapon$(), the swing lands a guaranteed hit on the nearest hostile target inside the domain even if it cleaves only air at a distance (based on the player's current attack damage, ignoring distance and direction).$(br2)$(bold)Targets$(): every living creature inside except those on the caster's side (the caster themself, their shikigami, cursed spirits, guardians, and tamed pets).$(br2)This domain is a self-enhancing domain for the caster and applies no negative effects to targets directly - the universal resistance period and the three New Shadow Style techniques cannot interfere with the caster's guaranteed hits.
